signal_text: A Gumroad help center article on customer interaction (dated October 27, 2022) states that customers have a specified amount of time, usually 90 days from the date of sale, to request a chargeback through their bank, and that Gumroad as the merchant cannot prevent chargebacks from happening but will dispute them in some cases.
subject_exact: Gumroad chargeback process definition with typical 90-day customer window and Gumroad inability to prevent chargebacks
local_qualifiers: in some cases we will dispute them
extraction_notes: 'Usually 90 days' — 'usually' qualifier preserved; actual window may vary by card network. Gumroad described as merchant in chargeback context. Source October 2022.
